description: This file declares the PlaybackService class, which implements the IPlaybackService interface. It manages media playback, shared memory buffers, and web audio players within the Rialto server service component. The class provides methods to control activation state, configure maximum concurrent playbacks and web audio players, and access media pipeline and web audio services.

classes.name: PlaybackService
classes.description: Implements the IPlaybackService interface, managing media playback, shared memory, and web audio services within the Rialto server.
